threads.body: This skips schema validation for every content attribute whose value is null, not just the new map-shaped prompt variables. For example, `gen_ai.input.messages = null` now escapes the violation even though its schema requires an array. Please scope the Weaver workaround to `gen_ai.prompt.variables` so validation of the existing array-valued attributes remains intact.

threads.body: The [prompt-variables schema in semconv #696](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/pull/696) permits arbitrary string property names, including the empty string, but this filter silently changes `{"": 42, "name": "Ada"}` to `{"name": "Ada"}`. Retain all sanitized string keys and update the new assertions in `tests/test_utils.py` that classify empty-string keys as invalid.

threads.body: Neither Bedrock's nor LangChain's conformance scenarios supply prompt variables, so those runs never exercise the new structured attribute. Extend the inference and streaming scenarios with Bedrock `promptVariables` and LangChain prompt-template inputs, asserting the resulting maps on spans and detail events as required by the [conformance rule](instrumentation/AGENTS.md#conformance-tests). Declare any pinned-registry limitation as an explicit gap.
